examples.arabic: طيب انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق عايزة حاجه
examples.english: Okay, I'm going to buy some things from the market, do you want anything?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq, ayza haga?

examples.arabic: طيب يا حبيبتي فين المكان الجديد ده
examples.english: Okay my dear. Where is this new place?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb ya habibty feen el makan el gedid da.

examples.arabic: طيب تشربي شاي ولا قهوة عندنا
examples.english: Okay, would you like to drink tea or coffee with us?
examples.transliteration: Tayeb, teshraaby shay wala ahwa andena?

examples.arabic: صباح النور يا سارة الحمد لله بخير انتي عاملة ايه
examples.english: Good morning, Sara, praise be to God, I'm fine. How are you?
examples.transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Sara, alhamdulillah bekheir, enti aamla eih?

examples.arabic: انا قلت الحمد لله انا بخير
examples.english: I said, "Praise be to God, I am fine."
examples.transliteration: Ana olt el hamdulillah ana bikheir.

examples.arabic: رد احمد وقالي الحمد لله بخير انت اللي عامل ايه يا صاحبي
examples.english: Ahmed replied and told me, "Praise be to God, I'm fine. How are you, my friend?"
examples.transliteration: Radd Ahmed w-qali "Elhamdullah bikheir, enta elli aamel eh ya saahbi?"

examples.arabic: بابا بيقول شكرا واحنا بنوصل البيت
examples.english: My dad says thank you and we arrive at the house.
examples.transliteration: baba beyeool shokran wa ehna benewsal el beit

examples.arabic: هو قال شكرا وانا كنت فرحان اوي
examples.english: He said thank you and I was very happy.
examples.transliteration: howa aal shokran wa ana kont farhan awy

examples.arabic: شكرا جدا انتي جارة كويسة اوي
examples.english: Thank you very much, you are a very good neighbor.
examples.transliteration: shokran gedan enty gara kowaysa awy

examples.arabic: انا ضحكت وقلت له يلا معلش نتكلم بعدين
examples.english: I laughed and told him, "Okay, never mind, let's talk later."
examples.transliteration: ana dehekt w olteloh yalla maalesh netkallem ba'dein

examples.arabic: شكرا يا حبيبتي معلش بعدين انا ماشية سلام
examples.english: Thank you, my dear, never mind, later, I'm going, bye.
examples.transliteration: Shokran ya habibty, ma'lesh ba'dein, ana mashya, salaam.

examples.arabic: اه معلش الكورة طارت بعيد اوي
examples.english: Oh, never mind, the ball flew very far.
examples.transliteration: Ah ma'alesh el koora tarat ba'eed awi.

examples.arabic: ام احمد ابتسمت وقالت بجد تسلم ايدك يا جارتي انا جاية حالا
examples.english: Umm Ahmed smiled and said 'Really Thank you so much my neighbor I'm coming right away.'
examples.transliteration: Omm Ahmed ibtasamet we 'alet begad teslam eidek ya garti ana gayya halan

examples.arabic: مصطفى: ماشي يا يوسف، أشوفك بكرة!
examples.english: Mostafa: Okay, Youssef, see you tomorrow!
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Mashi ya Youssef, ashoofak bokra!

examples.arabic: قلت له ماشي هنتقابل بالليل
examples.english: I told him okay we will meet at night.
examples.transliteration: olt loh mashy hantabel bellel

examples.arabic: هو قالي ماشي شكرا واقفلنا السكة
examples.english: He told me, "Okay, thank you," and we hung up.
examples.transliteration: howwa ally mashy shokran w affelna el-sekka

examples.arabic: السلام عليكم يا احمد عامل ايه النهارده
examples.english: Peace be upon you Ahmed how are you doing today
examples.transliteration: Assalamu alaykum ya Ahmed amel eh ennaharda

examples.arabic: السلام عليكم يا احمد عامل ايه النهارده
examples.english: Peace be upon you Ahmed how are you doing today
examples.transliteration: Assalamu alaykum ya Ahmed amel eh ennaharda

examples.arabic: السلام عليكم يا صاحبي عامل ايه النهارده
examples.english: Peace be upon you my friend, how are you doing today?
examples.transliteration: As salamu alaykum ya sahbi amel eh ennaharda
examples.storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

examples.arabic: أنا عايز سلام للعالم كله في العيد ده.
examples.english: I want peace for the whole world during this holiday.
examples.transliteration: Ana ayiz salam lil-alam kullo fi el-eid da.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: السلام عليكم يا احمد عامل ايه النهارده
examples.english: Peace be upon you Ahmed how are you doing today
examples.transliteration: Assalamu alaykum ya Ahmed amel eh ennaharda

examples.arabic: السلام عليكم يا احمد عامل ايه النهارده
examples.english: Peace be upon you Ahmed how are you doing today
examples.transliteration: Assalamu alaykum ya Ahmed amel eh ennaharda

examples.arabic: البياع اداني تفاحة ببلاش وقال لنا الله يسلمك
examples.english: The seller gave me an apple for free and said to us may God keep you safe.
examples.transliteration: El-bayya' eddani toffaha bebalash wa aal lina Allah yisallimik.

examples.arabic: قلت مع السلامة وهو قال الله يسلمك
examples.english: I said "Goodbye" and he said "May God keep you safe"
examples.transliteration: 'Olt ma'a salama w howa 'al Allah yisallimak

examples.arabic: بعد الاكل قالت مها مع السلامة ورد العم الله يسلمك
examples.english: After the meal, Maha said, "Goodbye," and the uncle replied, "May God keep you safe."
examples.transliteration: Ba3d el-akl 'alit Maha ma3a salama wi radd el-3amm Allah yisallimak.

examples.arabic: هو قال ربنا يخليك يا صاحبي لازم نقعد سوا قريب
examples.english: He said: "May God keep you, my friend, we must meet again soon."
examples.transliteration: Howa 'al: rabana yikhalleek ya saHby, lazim no'od sawa 'orayeb.

examples.arabic: اكيد هاجي تسلمي يا حبيبتي
examples.english: Of course I'll come, thank you my dear.
examples.transliteration: Akid hagi teslami ya habibti.

examples.arabic: تسلمي يا حبيبتي ان شاء الله اجيلك بعد الظهر مع السلامة
examples.english: Thank you my dear, God willing I'll come to you in the afternoon, goodbye.
examples.transliteration: Teslami ya habibti in sha'Allah agilak ba'd el-dohr ma'a salama.

examples.arabic: ردت ام علي وقالت تسلمي يا حبيبتي تعالي كلي معانا
examples.english: Umm Ali replied 'Thank you my dear Come eat with us.'
examples.transliteration: Raddet Omm Ali we 'alet teslami ya habibti ta'ali koli ma'ana

examples.arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي بس قلت انا اسف على التاخير
examples.english: I was very happy but I said I am sorry for the delay.
examples.transliteration: Kont mabsout awy bas olt ana asef ala el takheer.

examples.arabic: انا قلت انا اسف على التاخير
examples.english: I said I am sorry for the delay.
examples.transliteration: Ana olt ana asef ala el takheer.

examples.arabic: هو قال انا اسف على التاخير بتاع الكورة
examples.english: He said, 'I'm sorry for the ball's delay'.
examples.transliteration: Howa ʾāl ana āsef ʿala et-taʾkhīr betāʿ el-kora.

examples.arabic: أهلاً بيكي يا منى أنا كويسة الحمد لله وربنا يخليكي
examples.english: Welcome to you Mona, I'm good thank God, and may God keep you safe.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya Mona ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah w rabena yekhalleeki.

examples.arabic: ربنا يخليكي الاولاد عاملين ايه النهاردة
examples.english: May God bless you. How are the children today?
examples.transliteration: Rabena yekhalleeki el awlad amleen eh el naharda

examples.arabic: ربنا يخليكي ليا يا ام حسن ده كلام يفرح
examples.english: May God bless you, Um Hassan, that's comforting words.
examples.transliteration: Rabbena yekhaleeki leya ya om Hassan, da kalam yefarra7.

examples.arabic: أنا بقول لها أنا من اسكندرية وبنقول باي للكل
examples.english: I tell her "I am from Alexandria" and we say "bye" to everyone.
examples.transliteration: Ana ba'ool laha "Ana min Eskandareya" w ben'ool "Bye" lel kol.

examples.arabic: ضحكت وقلت له شكرا باي واشتريت موز
examples.english: I laughed and told him "Thank you, bye," and bought bananas.
examples.transliteration: Dehekt w oltiloh shukran bye, w eshtareet mawz.

examples.arabic: قبل ما امشي قلت شكرا يا عمو باي
examples.english: Before I left, I said, "Thank you, uncle, bye."
examples.transliteration: Qabl ma amshi olt "Shukran ya 'ammo, bye."

examples.arabic: علي راح على القهوة، وفعلاً لقى عمو محمود قاعد بيشرب شاي وبيتصفح كتاب. سلم عليه بحماس: "أهلاً يا عمو محمود! إزيك يا جميل؟" عمو محمود قال: "أهلاً بيك يا علي! أنا كويس الحمد لله، لما بكون مبسوط كده بقعد هنا."
examples.english: Aly went to the coffeehouse, and indeed found Uncle Mahmoud sitting, drinking tea and browsing a book. He greeted him enthusiastically: "Hello, Uncle Mahmoud! How are you, beautiful?" Uncle Mahmoud said: "Welcome, Aly! I'm fine, thank God. When I'm happy like this, I sit here."
examples.transliteration: Aly rah ala el-ahwa, w fa'lan laqa ammo Mahmoud qa'ed biyeshrab shay w biyetsaflah ketab. Sallim aleih behamas: "Ahlan ya ammo Mahmoud! Izzayak ya gameel?" Ammo Mahmoud qal: "Ahlan beek ya Aly! Ana kwayyes el-hamdu lellah, lamma bakoon mabsoot keda baq'ud hena."
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: اول ما دخلوا كل واحد سلم بحرارة وقال السلام عليكم
examples.english: As soon as they entered, everyone greeted warmly and said "Peace be upon you".
examples.transliteration: Awwel ma dakhalu kol wahed sallam beharaara w al As-salamu alaykum

examples.arabic: النهاردة الصبح وانا نازل شفت جارتي ام احمد على السلم سلمت عليها
examples.english: This morning as I was going down, I saw my neighbor Umm Ahmed on the stairs and greeted her.
examples.transliteration: Ennaharda eṣ-ṣobḥ wana nāzel shoft gārti Omm Aḥmed ʿala s-sollem sallamt ʿalēha

examples.arabic: اهلا يا علي ازيك
examples.english: Hello Ali, how are you?
examples.transliteration: Ahlan ya Ali, Ezzayak?

examples.arabic: اهلا يا منى انا لسه نايمه عشان تعبانه من الشغل
examples.english: Hello Mona, I am still sleeping because I am tired from work.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan ya Mona, ana lessa nayma ashan taabana min el shoghl.
examples.storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

examples.arabic: سلمت عليه وقلت له السلام عليكم يا احمد ازيك انا كويس الحمد لله فرد علي وقاللي اهلا بيك مش معقول
examples.english: I greeted him and said, "Hello Ahmed, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah." He replied, "Welcome, unbelievable!"
examples.transliteration: Sallimt aleih w qoltelo As-salamu alaykum ya Ahmed izzayyak ana kwayyes alhamdulillah fa radd aleiya w qalli Ahlan beek mish ma'oul.

examples.arabic: ورد الكبار وعليكم السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته يلا بينا ناكل
examples.english: The elders responded "And upon you be peace and God's mercy and blessings" and "Let's eat".
examples.transliteration: W radd el-kobaar Wa alaykum as-salam w rahmet Allah w barakatuh yalla bina nakol

examples.arabic: وعليكم السلام، الحمد لله كويس، وانت؟
examples.english: And upon you be peace, thank God I am good, and you?
examples.transliteration: Wa alaykum as salam, elhamdullelah kwayes, wenta?

examples.arabic: امي بترد وعليكم السلام
examples.english: My mother replies and upon you be peace
examples.transliteration: Ommi betrod wa alaykum as-salam

examples.arabic: الجد ضحك وقال وعليكم السلام بس فين فطارك
examples.english: The grandfather laughed and said and upon you be peace but where is your breakfast
examples.transliteration: El ged dehek wa aal wa alaykum as salam bas feen fetarak

words.english: and may it make you happy
